text:
carol_cs: Morning team  posting FinBridge weekly health snapshot. Quick hit: overall usage +2% WoW, 5xx rate +2.6% (spikes during nightly jobs), timeouts +5.1% concentrated on bulk embeddings and async generate. 429s briefly up during customer-region peak. Top failing endpoints and windows below.
harry_sre: drop the top endpoints + any correlated infra signals pls.
carol_cs: top offenders (last 7d):
- POST /v1/embeddings/bulk  timeouts ~2.9% (batches >25), spike 14:20-15:10 UTC
- POST /api/v1/generate/async  5xx ~1.0% (502/503), spike 02:10-03:00 UTC aligning with nightly ingest
- POST /v1/events/upload  timeouts 0.6% during large file loads, spike 01:30-02:00 UTC
- POST /v1/chat/stream  rate_limit 0.7% at 18:00-18:30 local peak (bursting users)
- POST /internal/retry-proxy  5xx 0.4% correlated with client retry storms
sophia_prod: note we enabled larger default batch-size for some enterprise tenants two weeks ago; could be amplifying bulk embed/timeouts.
harry_sre: infra notes  short GPU preemption on dedicated pool 02:14 UTC and IO wait on ingest nodes 01:25-01:50 UTC. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/finbridge/errors?from=now-7d&to=now Traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/finbridge/sample/1769999
harry_sre: quick minimal repro for embed timeout (use --max-time to emulate client SLAs):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"inputs": ["<very long text>"], "model":"embed-enterprise"}' --max-time 12
```
rita_pm: renewal meeting in 10 days. Should we consider this a talking point?
carol_cs: medium risk. Customer mentioned "intermittent timeouts" on ops call. If we can show clear mitigations before the renewal, we can probably keep the deal. Proposed immediate steps:
- short-term (today): edge soft-throttle for bulk embed requests >20 items + increase gateway idle timeout for ingest (owner: harry_sre)
- short-medium (48-72h): offer customer SDK chunking guidance and patch to chunk batches by default for FinBridge (owner: sophia_prod)
- medium (1 week): schedule dedicated capacity bump during 01:30-03:30 UTC for next 5 nights while we monitor (owner: carol_cs)
harry_sre: will open gateway throttle PR and canary today, will post link. Also enabling additional alerting for preempt events.
sophia_prod: will draft SDK patch and customer dev note, will coordinate with DevEx for rollout (ETA 48h).
pager-bot: alert: FinBridge embed timeout threshold breached (last 1h = 55, threshold = 40)
carol_cs: action items: 
- harry_sre: edge throttle PR + canary (due: today COB)
- sophia_prod: SDK patch + chunking guidance (due: 48h)
- carol_cs: schedule capacity bump & prep renewal slide (due: before renewal meeting)
- pager-bot: continue to post alerts and page on >2x breach
harry_sre: quick staging sim reduced embed timeouts ~60% with throttle. Will proceed to canary tonight if no objections.
carol_cs: thanks all. I'll prepare the customer-facing summary after canary is green and share a concise ops note here. :thumbsup:
